verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own per-card spend limits on issued Visa debit/credit cards with real-time tracking, which enforce caps automatically. It also offers up to 20 checking accounts that can be nicknamed and funded by automatic percentage or amount transfers, which could serve as budget envelopes. However, nothing documents a department- or program-level budget object with enforced limits. Mapping accounts and cards to departments is a manual arrangement. missing for 10: explicit department/program budget feature, budget-level (not per-card) automatic enforcement, budget-vs-actual reporting, independent hands-on corroboration of limit enforcement.
